sentence: Weed the flower beds in the backyard.

service_lines.uncertain: Both photos are extreme close-up shots of individual plants, not wide or medium shots of a flower bed. Photo 1 shows a mixed planting (pink bleeding-heart flowers, fern-like blue-green foliage, broad green leaves, and dark purple groundcover) that reads as an intentional planting rather than clear weed growth. Photo 2 shows a young caged shrub surrounded by cut/dried grass and twigs, which could be weeds, mulch, or leftover cutting debris. Neither photo shows enough of the bed or the ground within it to judge how many beds exist, how weedy they are, or what severity applies, so I can't report a quantity or severity for this line.
